verdict_reason: Fresh valid Component perturbations disprove the claimed invariant for explicit left/up reversed relations involving named-note endpoints. Java paints the ordinary SvekEdge link groups with the named-note entity UID, while the frozen Rust binary silently omits those link groups after Opale has correctly declined suppression.
commands: for f in test-diagrams/perturbations/component-named-note-ordinary-edge-lifecycle/*.puml; do /private/tmp/rustuml-component-note-edges/target/release/rustuml -tsvg "$f" > "${f%.puml}.rust.svg" || exit $?; done
python3 inventory comparator over each Java SVG and frozen Rust SVG, writing same-stem .diff.txt files

java_evidence: GraphvizImageBuilder.isOpalisable at lines 133-147 suppresses only non-strict, non-group NOTE leaves with exactly one visible incident link whose other endpoint is not a note.
GraphvizImageBuilder.buildImage at lines 240-259 constructs every SvekEdge and adds it to Bibliotekon before optional Opale marking.
GraphvizImageBuilder.onlyOneLink at lines 313-326 counts every non-invisible incident link and returns null after the second.
Bibliotekon.createNode/getNode at lines 72-77 and 120-121 use one nodeMap for all entities, including named notes.
SvekEdge.drawU at lines 824-849 skips only Opale, invisible, or unsolved paths before starting a generic link group with entity metadata.
rust_evidence: component_opalized_floating_note correctly suppresses only exactly-one incident named-note relations, so the failing multiply linked notes are not Opale-suppressed.
no_oracle_layout_edge_ends reverses logical endpoints for Up and Left at component.rs:6857-6866.

The ordinary paint loop then mixes endpoint bases: component/interface geometry is resolved from conn.from/conn.to at component.rs:3576-3596, while note/package geometry is resolved from logical_from/logical_to at component.rs:3597-3611.

When a Left/Up relation reverses a component-note pair, the component branch consumes the unreversed endpoint and the note lookup is attached to the reversed endpoint; the opposite endpoint misses and hits continue at component.rs:3632-3652 before a link group is opened.
source_review.fixture_shape_search: I found no shipping branch keyed to the fresh checker labels. The surviving defect is an endpoint-direction ownership error, not label-shaped fixture logic.

comparison_method.note: No scripts/diff_one.sh or prebuilt diff_one helper existed in the requested checkout, and the user forbade Cargo. I used an equivalent mechanism comparator: pinned Java JAR SVGs, frozen rustuml SVGs, and same-stem SVG inventories for entity IDs, note qualified names, link IDs, source lines, endpoint entity IDs, link types, Opale suppression, and Java/Rust error markers.
comparison_method.error_scan: No generated Java or Rust SVG contains Syntax Error, PlantUML diagram description errors, Java exceptions, or Rust parse errors.
comparison_method.summary: 8 held-outs pass the mechanism inventory, 3 fresh held-outs fail.

findings.title: Explicit Left/Up component-note links are still dropped
evidence: checker_04_nested_lr_note_both_reversed_left.diff.txt: Java has three links; Rust has one, missing lnk7 and lnk9 note-endpoint links.
checker_07_root_tb_up_arrow_destination_cardinality.diff.txt: Java has three links; Rust has two, missing lnk6 reverse UpMemo971->Collector971 with cardinalities.
checker_11_nested_lr_inline_multiline_note_note_reversed.diff.txt: Java has three links; Rust has two, missing lnk8 InlineMemo1011->Alpha1013.
findings.mechanism: Rust reverses logical endpoints for Left/Up layout, but ordinary endpoint geometry still resolves component/interface endpoints from conn.from/conn.to and note/package endpoints from logical_from/logical_to. A reversed relation with one component endpoint and one note endpoint can therefore bind the component side to the wrong endpoint and miss the note side, hitting continue before the link group is emitted.
findings.java_contrast: Java's SvekEdge owns the reversed Link after CommandLinkElement inversion and paints it generically unless the line is Opale, invisible, or unsolved.

verdict_gate: Under T14, a single valid failing counterexample rejects the mechanism. Three fresh valid counterexamples are preserved in the perturbation directory.
